description: Defines interfaces and classes for WebSocket stream handling, including creation, connection, reading, writing, and error handling within the Chromium networking codebase.

classes.name: WebSocketStreamRequest
classes.description: Handle for creating a WebSocketStream, allows cancellation before success or failure callbacks.

classes.name: WebSocketStreamRequestAPI
classes.description: Extends WebSocketStreamRequest with methods used during handshake, such as stream creation callbacks and failure notification.

classes.name: WebSocketStream
classes.description: Abstract interface for WebSocket stream operations including connect, read, write, and close.

classes.name: WebSocketStream::ConnectDelegate
classes.description: Interface for receiving connection results, including success, failure, request creation, SSL errors, and authentication.

methods.name: CreateAndConnectStream
methods.description: Creates and initiates connection of a WebSocketStream with specified parameters.

methods.name: CreateAndConnectStreamForTesting
methods.description: Testing variant of CreateAndConnectStream with additional parameters for testing.

methods.name: ReadFrames
methods.description: Reads WebSocket frames asynchronously, returning status or error codes.

methods.name: WriteFrames
methods.description: Writes WebSocket frames asynchronously, returning status or error codes.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the WebSocket stream, cancelling pending I/O.

methods.name: GetNetLogWithSource
methods.description: Returns the NetLog source for logging.
